integrity: Source equations and selected spectral comparisons are provided with a stand-alone analytical derivation and checker; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic and unregularized low-rank spectral right preconditioners; nested orthogonal-projection surrogates rather than demonstrated CUR sampler outputs; exact target singular levels. Condition number only, without claims about LSQR iterations.
title: A rank-increasing spectral preconditioner with strictly better surrogate error and unbounded conditioning penalty
